vibe_rationale: Iconic invitational tube-riding contest with local trials, but brand-owned and contest-only, so thin on wider community programming.
fit_notes: Rip Curl owns the contest, so any role is a direct deal in a non-competing category. Strong Australian link: a 16-year-old Australian won the 2026 women's title, and Australians were the largest source of Bali arrivals in 2025 (23.44 per cent, BPS Bali), though the event's share is unpublished.
